best: The 3V3 buck and the pack-path/power-stage drawings read as clean left-to-right textbook paths (input caps, switch, inductor, output caps) with titled blocks and explanatory notes.
worst: USB port sheets have many text overlaps (C458/D411/DRV_SUP, R425/C409, C414/C415, R415/TH401, R417/R435 labels on bodies) and tiny text on a huge sheet
BQ25756 gate-drive/sense nets run as long wires to labels (HG1, LG1, SW1) far from the four-switch stage, so the charger must be traced by name across the sheet
Poor space use: large empty regions on 3V3, MCU and the USB middle band while parts are crammed elsewhere; MCU pins mostly connect only by labels
